title: Remote State in S3 + DynamoDB
scenario: Configure a remote S3 backend with state locking via DynamoDB and encryption at rest.

focus.title: Complete the S3 backend configuration
focus.todo: Fill in the state bucket, key, region, DynamoDB lock table and encryption flag.

hints.why: State is Terraform's record of what it manages. A remote, locked and encrypted backend protects that record when more than one person or automation runs Terraform.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `versions.tf`. The work is inside `terraform` -> `backend "s3"`. Fill in the state bucket, key, region, DynamoDB lock table and encryption flag. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use a remote backend for any shared or production configuration. Local state is fine only for short-lived experiments.
hints.how: Open `versions.tf` and work only inside `terraform` -> `backend "s3"`. Use this code shape: bucket; key; region; dynamodb_table; encrypt. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
